description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing and retrieving employee performance trackers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing all trackers, retrieving a specific tracker by ID, and placeholders for create, update, and delete operations. It also contains validation rules and search filter parameters specific to performance tracking data.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing performance employee trackers, including listing and retrieving individual tracker details. Implements CRUD interface but only GET endpoints are currently functional.
